description: Spring Boot starter that adds tool policy, a human approval gate, a hash-chained audit trail in your own PostgreSQL database, and budgets to Spring AI tool calling and MCP servers.
rules: Upgrading from 0.1.x: re-apply the 0.1.2 schema-postgresql.sql once, as the role that owns the tables.
The audit-trail trigger check runs at startup only; a trigger switched off later is not seen until the next start.
Run the application as a separate database role from the table owner; the owner can still switch the triggers off.
